briefing.en: A locked door blocks the exit. A switch in the side room opens it. Plan the order of actions.
briefing.id: Sebuah pintu terkunci menghalangi jalan keluar. Saklar di ruang samping membukanya. Rencanakan urutan aksi.

en: The door tile D blocks you until a switch opens it.
robot.scan_object("right") tells you what is next to you.
Press the switch with robot.action(), then walk through the door.
id: Petak pintu D menghalangimu sampai saklar membukanya.
robot.scan_object("right") memberi tahu apa yang ada di sebelahmu.
Tekan saklar dengan robot.action(), lalu lewati pintu.

starter:
# Try walking right. What blocks you?
robot.move("right")

objects.event_message: Switch activated. The door is open.

objects.prerequisite_error: The exit is offline. Finish the earlier objective first.
